title: Yamaha C3
author: wesleywilson29
purpose: Acoustic reference for common piano behavior; not a user-facing Keyra instrument.
capture: The creator describes a Yamaha C3 in a converted garage, with condenser microphones near the piano holes, towels/foam treatment and an additional microphone underneath. The monolith groups are labelled MIC1; their exact microphone blend is unknown.
calibration_unknown: timing of pedal motion within recordings
rights: No audio is redistributed. No licence file was found in the source archive; the public download and these numeric pins do not grant redistribution rights.

pedal.release: The release group is ungated by CC64; recorded pedal state is unknown.
pedal.interpretation: Preset endpoint selection only; no measured half-pedal trajectory.

sequence: Preserve declared seqPosition labels. No seqMode is specified by the source preset; these labels do not establish playback sequencing or independent performances.
deduplication: Identical monolith coordinates become one file with all XML mappings as aliases. Equal PCM at different coordinates is retained for traceability but marked duplicate_pcm_of; exclude these aliases from observation counts and fitting weights. PCM SHA256 identity is audited separately against cross-role leakage.
